about: Recorded from lib/chordkey.lua's driven repeat by test/repeattiming.lua, fixture 0.3f, each run of a hold, its start and its depth. Run by test/repeattiming.lua and by olm-keys-check, the app's port, KeyRepeat. Record it again with --record after a change made on purpose.

cases.name: a hold past the delay repeats on the interval
a slow handler repeats slower, never in a burst
a handler slower than the delay delays the first repeat by nothing
